what_to_watch.title: Find points without Harper
what_to_watch.text: The Spurs scored 93 in the Detroit loss, and Harper is out with left hip soreness. Watch how Fox, Castle and Vassell share the creation and find clean shots against the Clippers.

what_to_watch.title: Keep Garland off his spots
what_to_watch.text: Darius Garland leads the Clippers with 21.2 points and 6.9 assists per game. Watch the Spurs navigate his screens and recover to shooters without giving up easy drives.

what_to_watch.title: Build on Wemby's work
what_to_watch.text: Wembanyama had 25 points and 18 rebounds against Detroit. Watch whether San Antonio can pair that interior presence with better perimeter shooting after going 9-for-40 from three in the loss.

what_to_watch.title: Make Wemby's size count
what_to_watch.text: With Jalen Duren out, watch whether Wembanyama can turn his size into paint touches and second chances. Detroit's replacement frontcourt still has to be beaten on the glass.

what_to_watch.title: Make Cade work for it
what_to_watch.text: Cade Cunningham leads Detroit with 25.7 points and 7.9 assists per game. Watch the Spurs' guards navigate screens and recover to shooters without giving him a clear path to the rim.

what_to_watch.title: Keep the streak moving
what_to_watch.text: The Spurs enter with 12 straight wins. Harper's 31 points helped finish the job in Utah; watch whether San Antonio can create good shots throughout the rotation and make it 13.
